title: Add Tailoring subcategory dropdown support, fix local icon system, and allow anonymous worker registration with admin-only publishing

requirements.text: Ensure the backend worker taxonomy returned by backend/main.mo:getAllCategories() includes Tailoring-related subcategories (including "Blouse Stitching" and "Saree Work"/"Saree Falls/Pico" as applicable) so they appear as selectable Subcategory dropdown options under the correct parent category in the frontend Worker Registration and Worker Search filters.

quotes: Tailoring போன்ற பெரிய categoryகளின் கீழ், blouse stitching, saree work போன்ற subcategories dropdown-ஆக வரட்டும்.

acceptanceCriteria: In Worker Registration, selecting the relevant Tailoring parent category enables a Subcategory dropdown that includes "Blouse Stitching" and the saree-related subcategory option.
In Worker Search Results filters, selecting the relevant Tailoring parent category enables a Subcategory dropdown that includes "Blouse Stitching" and the saree-related subcategory option.
Backend getAllCategories() returns these Tailoring subcategories under the correct parent category mapping (not under an unrelated category).

requirements.text: Remove the login/authentication requirement for submitting worker registrations: update backend/main.mo:submitWorkerRegistration to allow anonymous callers to submit a worker registration without trapping, while keeping the Admin Panel protected by Internet Identity and admin authorization.

quotes: Login authentication remove பண்ணி, எல்லோரும் register பண்ணலாம்

acceptanceCriteria: An anonymous user (not logged in) can submit the Worker Registration form successfully and receives the success confirmation state.
backend/main.mo:submitWorkerRegistration does not Runtime.trap for non-authenticated callers.
Admin-only endpoints (approve/reject/feature/verify, admin lists) remain restricted and still trap/deny for non-admins.

requirements.text: Keep admin-approval gating for public visibility: ensure newly submitted worker registrations remain non-public (pending) and are not returned by any public worker browsing/search endpoints until an admin approves them.

quotes: ஆனா admin approve ஆன பிறகு மட்டும் public-ஆக காண்பியுங்கள்.

acceptanceCriteria: A newly submitted worker registration is not returned by public search endpoints (area/category/subcategory) until approved.
After an admin approves a worker, the worker becomes visible in public search results matching the filters.
Worker status transitions remain consistent (#pendingVerification -> #approved/#rejected) and are enforced by the query filters.

requirements.text: Fix and standardize category/subcategory icon rendering so all category and subcategory icons are local generated assets (no external URLs), and remove broken image placeholders by ensuring the frontend uses existing SafeIconImage fallback behavior consistently with a single local fallback SVG file.

quotes: எல்லா categoryக்கும் சரியான icons local-ஆக generate பண்ணி set பண்ணுங்க.

acceptanceCriteria: All icons used on the Home page category grid and Local Skilled Workers subcategory grid load from frontend/public/assets/generated/* and render correctly.
SafeIconImage uses a local SVG fallback file (not a .png) that exists at the configured path.
No broken image placeholders appear when an icon is missing/invalid; the fallback icon renders instead.

requirements.text: Improve overall UX clarity for local users in the Worker Registration and Search flows without adding new product features: reduce confusion by ensuring category/subcategory selection is straightforward (clear placeholders, disabled/enabled states, and safe empty-state messaging) while preserving existing layout structure and mobile-first readability.

quotes: Overall, site user-friendlyயாகவும், local audience-க்கு புரியும்படியாகவும் AI design பண்ணட்டும்.

acceptanceCriteria: When no category is selected, the subcategory dropdown is clearly disabled and shows an appropriate placeholder state.
If taxonomy data is missing or empty, the UI remains usable using safe fallbacks (no crashes) and communicates a clear next step to the user.
No new flows (booking/payment/chat) are introduced; existing navigation and routes remain intact.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo changes if state migration is required.

Do not modify any frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Do not remove Internet Identity/admin authorization requirements for accessing the Admin Panel; the login removal applies only to worker registration submission.
Do not introduce booking, payment, or in-app chat; contact remains Call/WhatsApp only.
nonGoals: Adding new third-party authentication providers or alternative login methods beyond Internet Identity for admin access.
Introducing any external image hosting or external icon URLs.
Changing the overall information architecture or adding new pages/routes beyond what is necessary to support the requested dropdowns and icon fixes.
